localization.description: A single small, non-duplicative, reviewable contribution, submitted only with separate human authorization; if external action is unsafe or unavailable, use independent local review and a weaker label.
localization.instructions: Record the actual state: prepared, submitted, acknowledged, accepted, merged, published, rejected, withdrawn, unknown, or externally_reviewed_local. Acceptance is not required and must not be inferred.
localization.label: Bounded community transaction or externally reviewed local equivalent

localization.criterion_text: One target, one contribution, the version, locators, duplicate search, rights, and what will remain untouched are narrowly specified.
localization.label: Scope and non-duplication

localization.criterion_text: The diagnosis, minimal change, validation, attribution, limitations, withdrawal route, and one concise message can be reviewed as a single package.
localization.label: Package quality

localization.criterion_text: Each external action has separate human authorization for a specific target; without authorization, the package stops locally.
localization.label: Authorization to act

localization.criterion_text: Each external transition has event evidence; prepared is not called submitted, and submitted is not called accepted, merged, or published.
localization.label: Evidenced status

localization.criterion_text: If external action is unsafe or unavailable, an independent checker assesses the actual package and the result is labeled externally_reviewed_local, with no claim of community participation.
localization.label: Honest alternative route
Rubric — Bounded community transaction or externally reviewed local equivalent
localization.pass_rule: All mandatory criteria must be met; one unmet criterion requires revision.

localization.description: One review cycle with two different people serving as author and referee.
localization.instructions: Preserve the initial artifact, report, response, disposition table, revision, before/after evidence, identities or private IDs, and unresolved issues.
localization.label: Independent author–referee cycle

localization.criterion_text: The learner or author and the referee are two different people; their real identities or private IDs can be audited by the course assessor.
localization.label: Role independence

localization.criterion_text: The initial artifact, referee report, author's response, and final revision are frozen as separate versions without overwriting history.
localization.label: Complete version package

localization.criterion_text: Each significant comment identifies the target, locator, diagnosis, evidence, severity, confidence, and an executable action.
localization.label: Evidence-backed report

localization.criterion_text: Each comment is mapped to a decision, action, evidence, change location, status, and a reason if rejected or held.
localization.label: Disposition table

localization.criterion_text: Significant changes are checked against the initial and final artifacts; their impact and unresolved issues remain visible.
localization.label: Before/after evidence
Rubric — Independent author–referee cycle
localization.pass_rule: All mandatory criteria must be met; one unmet criterion requires revision.

localization.description: Attendance at or delivery of an actual mathematics seminar, or an accessible supervised equivalent, with an honest evidence record.
localization.instructions: Keep event evidence, timestamped notes, a dependency map, a question log, unavailable portions, corrections, and accessibility surfaces.
localization.label: Live seminar

localization.criterion_text: The event identity, time, learner's role, evidence of attendance or delivery, and limitations of the record can be checked.
localization.label: Event evidence

localization.criterion_text: The notes distinguish observations, verification, questions, objections, and inaudible or unavailable portions without inventing content.
localization.label: Timestamped notes

localization.criterion_text: The main claims, definitions, assumptions, lemmas, proofs, and open problems are mapped with sufficiently precise locators or timestamps.
localization.label: Dependency map

localization.criterion_text: The question log and corrected final notes preserve changes, their grounds, and unresolved items.
localization.label: Questions and corrections

localization.criterion_text: If live audio or video is unavailable, a supervised equivalent preserves the learning objectives and is labeled as an equivalent, not as an event that did not occur.

localization.pass_rule: All mandatory criteria must be met; one unmet criterion requires revision.

localization.description: Audit one real, openly accessible source with its version frozen, with a reproducible diagnosis, minimal correction, and independent mathematical check.
localization.instructions: Submission is not required and must not be inferred. Keep the version, rights, reproducer, correction, validation, independent check, impact, and uncertainty.
localization.label: Real-source erratum dossier

localization.criterion_text: The work, version, copy, locator, wording, check date, and rights of the actual source can be checked.
localization.label: Frozen openly accessible source

localization.criterion_text: The reproducer or reconstruction checks all hypotheses, demonstrates the failure minimally, and separates observation from proof.
localization.label: Reproducible diagnosis

localization.criterion_text: The proposed correction is the smallest sufficient change and is justified by a mathematical argument, without overstating its scope.
localization.label: Minimal correction

localization.criterion_text: A different person checks the diagnosis and correction, recording the decision, its grounds, their identity or private ID, and any remaining disagreement.
localization.label: Independent check

localization.criterion_text: The dossier distinguishes prepared, checked, and submitted; submission is not claimed without evidence, and impact beyond the scope remains unknown.
localization.label: Honest status and impact
Rubric — Real-source erratum dossier
localization.pass_rule: All mandatory criteria must be met; one unmet criterion requires revision.

localization.description: A search without a pre-seeded candidate list for one actual mathematics paper or monograph, whose version is frozen.
localization.instructions: Keep the question, queries, retrieval times, stopping rule, version, rights, authority comparison, decisions, and uncertainty.
localization.label: Real-source search

localization.criterion_text: One actual mathematics paper or monograph is frozen with a checkable work identity, version, copy, locator, retrieval date, and basis for rights.
localization.label: Actual target and version

localization.criterion_text: The question, all queries, discovery path, relevant negative results, and stopping rule are recorded without accepting a supplied candidate list as a substitute for searching.
localization.label: Unseeded search

localization.criterion_text: At least two candidate surfaces or sources are compared against a specific question; reputation and result ranking are not used as proof.
localization.label: Authority comparison

localization.criterion_text: The statement that a source contains a claim is separated from the decision that the claim is true, with explicit locators, grounds, and limits of inference.
localization.label: Claim audit

localization.criterion_text: Missing fields, version conflicts, inclusion decisions, and reasons for stopping are preserved without guessing.
localization.label: Uncertainty and decision trail
Rubric — Real-source search
localization.pass_rule: All mandatory criteria must be met; one unmet criterion requires revision.

localization.description: The assessment published in Unit 5 — Writing Auditable Mathematical Exposition.
localization.instructions: Use the prompt, evidence, mandatory gates, and rubric at the source locator bound to this record.

localization.criterion_text: the reader, purpose, prerequisites, format, and limitations consistently determine the details
localization.label: Reader and scope

localization.label: Claims and notation

localization.criterion_text: all three lemmas are used with correct contracts and produce a real root without gaps
localization.label: Proof path

localization.criterion_text: the illustration and two counterexamples precisely delimit existence, degree parity, and uniqueness
localization.label: Examples and limitations

localization.criterion_text: each claim can be located, local material is distinguished from external sources, and uncertainty is reported honestly
localization.label: Locators and citations

Rubric — Unit 5 completion
localization.pass_rule: The passing score is at least 10 out of 12, with a score of 2 for **Proof path** and **Locators and citations**. Inferring a unique root, applying the Intermediate Value Theorem without continuity or a sign change, inventing package metadata, or using a numerical example as universal proof requires revision even when the total score is sufficient. The three-part revision note, signposts, two unproved limitations, and eight-minute limit are also mandatory gates, not optional items compensated by other scores.
